visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Tower of Hanoi
visualizerParams.description: To move n disks from one peg to another: move n - 1 disks out of the way, move the biggest disk, then move the n - 1 disks on top of it.

tests.pattern:
(?<![\s\S])\s*Move disk 1 from A to C[ 	]*?
Move disk 2 from A to B[ 	]*?
Move disk 1 from C to B[ 	]*?
Move disk 3 from A to C[ 	]*?
Move disk 1 from B to A[ 	]*?
Move disk 2 from B to C[ 	]*?
Move disk 1 from A to C\s*(?![\s\S])
